scope: Repair public homepage token discovery and exact currency identities; add liquidity-first candidates, bounded pagination, descriptive cautions and reason-specific lookup recovery.

backend.verification: Observed head; unchanged by this repair, not a backend re-audit.

root_causes: XRPL Meta treats the presence of decode_currency as true even when the query value is false, returning display labels in place of raw ledger currency. Passing original_icons=false likewise enables that presence-based option. Omitting both flags preserves raw currency and expected icon behavior.

Provider catalog order and partial bounded checks did not establish complete or liquidity-ranked discovery; decoded identities caused liquid assets such as SOLO/RLUSD to be rejected or queried incorrectly.

The generic lookup-unavailable label concealed operational distinctions among transient transport errors, rate limits, invalid identities and valid ledger no-pool responses. No evidence of deliberate concealment was established.
changes: Omit presence-based Meta flags and preserve exact raw currency independently from display labels; known SOLO bootstrap uses its real 40-character currency encoding.
Use documented XRPL.to TVL-ordered token discovery as the preferred candidate source with attribution; retain broad all-trust-level Meta fallback/select and exact issuer/currency lookup.
Start with 50 candidates including four known seeds (XRBC, XRB, JCS, SOLO); load more in bounded batches and render at most 100 rows per page.
Rank fresh validated direct XRP-AMM reserve observations among loaded tokens. Provider TVL helps discovery only; it is not substituted for measured XRP reserve.
Explain thin liquidity, absent direct XRP pool and unavailable evidence; show 100 XRP as a share of observed reserve, with published 1000/10000 XRP bands and no intrinsic-value claim.
Add reason-specific failures and per-row retry, one paced retry for transient lookup errors, rate-limit cooldown and stale/cancelled-result guards.
Keep index wallet-free and read-only. Change only index markup/CSS/module and the CSP connection allowance for api.xrpl.to; trading/wallet code remains outside changed blocks.
Add nine focused regression tests and the measurable discovery/usefulness/efficiency memory standard.
Export discovery attribution and source documentation with JSON evidence; final small source commit after initial implementation.
